custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide. For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on. For example: ZZAUTOTEST SV11581 Ana.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an Approved work order {Work-order-1} led by {Technician-A}, with one approved line that has {Technician-A} on it and a total above $0. For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SV11581 Card Size.
  • In Board View, "Column Selection" has "Service Advisor", "Line Count", "Estimated Hours" and "Line Technicians" on, and "Created Date" and "VIN/Serial" off (Line Technicians puts the crew avatars on the card); "Card size" is on "Detailed".
  • {User-B} is a user at {Location-A} whose role does not have "See Financial Data" (for example the "View Only" role).
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
